subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The farmer stood by the roadside stand to sell his _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Produce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Produce"** refers to agricultural products, especially fresh fruits and vegetables that are grown for sale. (उपज)

 
 
• **Example:** The farmer loaded his truck with fresh produce to sell at the market.
 
 
 
• **"Produce" **is the correct word here because farmers typically sell their harvested crops and goods at roadside stands.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Produce)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Volume** (मात्रा): Refers to the amount or quantity of something, often in terms of space occupied.

 
 
• **Example:** The volume of water in the tank is measured regularly.
 
 
 
• **Consequence** (परिणाम): Refers to the result or effect of an action or decision.
 
 
• **Example:** He faced serious consequences for breaking the rules.
 
 
 
• **Productivity** (उत्पादकता): Refers to the efficiency or output of production, especially in work or agriculture.
 
 
• **Example:** The new techniques improved the productivity of the farm.
